input: Map out a realistic debt payoff snowball plan

gold.taskTitle: Map Out a Realistic Debt Snowball Payoff Plan
gold.taskDescription: Create a structured, step-by-step debt snowball plan that lists debts from smallest to largest and applies extra payments progressively as each debt is paid off.

questions.title: How many separate debts do you currently have?
questions.description: Understand the total number of individual debts to be included in the snowball plan.

questions.title: What is the balance and minimum payment on each debt?
questions.description: Collect the exact current balance and required minimum monthly payment for every debt.

questions.title: What is the interest rate on each of those debts?
questions.description: Gather the APR or interest rate for each debt to understand cost and inform ordering.

questions.title: How much extra money can you put toward debt each month?
questions.description: Determine the additional monthly amount available beyond all minimum payments combined.

questions.title: Is your monthly income and expense situation currently stable?
questions.description: Understand whether income or expenses are likely to change, which affects plan reliability.

questions.title: Do you have any existing emergency savings set aside?
questions.description: Clarify whether a financial safety net exists so the plan does not get derailed by unexpected costs.

questions.title: What is your target date or urgency for becoming debt-free?
questions.description: Establish whether there is a specific deadline or milestone driving the timeline of the plan.
